status: STUDY / PROTOTYPE (Track F1 reference WF-F1-P6.0, nominal case); noncanon; production farm unchanged

alternatives.name: Stretch
pros: one vessel set, same tooling and supports
no new deck, outlets or ring mains
cons: ship +18.2 m; Brow, EYE, lances and forward assembly move forward (every forward interface re-anchored)
vessel L/D 3.5 (L) and 4.1 (M): forward guides and the keel rails grow; barrel buckling under lateral loads needs a check
propellant centroid moves forward: pitch inertia rises

alternatives.name: Tandem modular segment
pros: mission-modular: the forward segment and its deck are fitted only when a mission needs the volume
short barrels (no slenderness growth); the base farm and its interfaces are unchanged
a segment is an exchangeable unit (yard-level, not LOG-G1)
cons: 23.9 m added (longer than T-A: a second deck, 13 more heads)
shell area +9 % over T-A: tankage and boil-off surface grow
13 more outlets, a second ring main per species, transfer lines through the base farm

alternatives.name: Densify and re-allocate
cons: slush production, transfer and ageing (solid fraction falls with boil-off) need a register entry (FT-09 proposed)
re-allocation breaks the per-species zero-moment placement: rerun the balance search (mass_model.balance)
helium-3 cannot be densified (no solid at tank pressure): it still sets most of the stretch

alternatives.name: Wider or more vessels (screened)
alternatives.reason: vessel-to-vessel gap 1.00 m (rule 1.0), lanes -0.001 m, girder panels 0.50 m (rule 0.5): every class is at its limit; the Brow silhouette (r 45 m) is not the limit (farm reach 34.5 m). Growth needs a new azimuth search with fewer, larger vessels; a +0.5 m envelope on the outer ring alone would close the gap to 0

recommendation.pick: T-A (stretch) as the F1 3D reference; T-B kept as the mission-modular variant
recommendation.why: T-A adds 18.2 m with the least shell and no new interfaces; T-B costs 5.6 m and +64 t more but lets the farm follow the mission; T-C saves 1.8 m only with a new technology entry and a new balance search, so it stays an option
recommendation.owner_question: DR-3D-01: confirm T-A as the 3D reference, or ask for T-B (modular) or T-C (densified)
